description.en: Free & open-source, ready-to-use, customizable PDF components for React. Copy, paste, and ship. Built on Takumi and Forme, works with shadcn/ui.
description.zh: 为 React 打造的高颜值可定制 PDF 打印排版组件库：基于 Takumi 与 Forme 构建，与 shadcn/ui 无缝契合，支持即拷即用。

content.en: pdfcn solves the long-standing developer pain of generating aesthetically pleasing, print-ready PDF documents from React applications. Built on top of Takumi and Forme, and designed to match the visual language of shadcn/ui, it provides clean, modular components for invoices, receipts, contracts, resumes, and formal certificates. It handles complex PDF typography, page breaks, header/footer pagination, and table overflow automatically.
content.zh: pdfcn 彻底终结了前端开发在 React 中生成高颜值、可排版打印 PDF 文件的噩梦。组件库深度结合 Takumi 与 Forme 排版引擎，在视觉规范上完美对齐 shadcn/ui 设计哲学。开箱提供商业发票、财务收据、聘用合同、求职简历、认证证书等多种企业级排版模板，自动处理跨页断页、页眉页脚页码计算、多列网格及防伪水印。
